items.stated_text: On September 14th, 2023, the Government has approved the National Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2030, which includes, among its performance indicators, a clause that by the end of 2024 - 75% of all public services will be digitized, and by 2030 - all public services will be digital.
items.summary: The 2023-2030 digital strategy set indicators: 75% of public services digitised by end 2024, and all by 2030.

items.stated_text: According to STISC data from September 2022, there were 129,384 active certificates of the public key for qualified advanced electronic signatures, of which 97,633 (75.45% of the total) were USB tokens: 18,400 were Mobile ID certificates issued by Orange Moldova, 17,725 were Mobile ID certificates issued by Moldcell, and 66 were eID cards issued by the Public Services Agency. items.summary: September 2022: 129,384 active qualified e-signature certificates; 97,633 tokens held by only 45,870 unique users.
